methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.description: The rules, priorities and data limitations to consider when reviewing the graph.
methodology.readDescription: The graph shows observed directed transfers within the supplied dataset. Roles and priorities help select nodes for manual review. They do not establish intent, identify an organiser, trace particular funds or determine guilt.
methodology.metric.flows: Observed incoming and outgoing amounts, excluding self-transfers.
methodology.metric.degree: The number of distinct payers and recipients.
methodology.metric.ratio: The flow ratio when I > 0, the node is not a seed and its depth is not 4.
methodology.metric.seeds: The number of other seed nodes with a directed path of length 1–4 to this node.
methodology.metric.centrality: Directed betweenness centrality; transfer amounts are not treated as distances.
methodology.rolesDescription: The first matching rule is applied from top to bottom. The role_score value measures the strength of the indicators, not a probability.
methodology.rule.R1: depth < 4; Uin ≥ 2; Uout ≥ 2; S ≥ 3; B > 0 and B ≥ Q95(B+).
methodology.rule.R6: None of the preceding rules matched.
methodology.rolesNote: For R1, the Q95(B+) threshold is calculated using strictly positive B values; the rule is disabled if there are none. For R6, role_score is 0.1 for an isolated node or a node at depth 4, and 0.3 otherwise.
methodology.priorityDescription: The ranking uses weighted percentiles of the observed metrics and the weight of the assigned role:
methodology.priorityFormula: P(x)=0 when x ≤ 0 or N ≤ 1; otherwise, P(x) is the number of nodes u with xᵤ < x divided by N−1. W(role): coordinator 1.0; consolidator 0.95; distributor 0.85; transit node 0.65; terminal node 0.55; peripheral node 0.10.
methodology.priorityOrder: Isolated nodes have zero priority. Sorting is deterministic: score descending, then numeric gid ascending. This is a manual review queue, not a ranking of guilt.
methodology.clustersDescription: For the undirected projection, amounts in both directions between each pair of nodes are added together. The weight is log1p of that sum, and self-loops are excluded. Louvain runs on components with edges, with resolution=1 and seed=42. Betweenness centrality is directed and normalised, with k=min(128,N), seed=42 and no monetary weight. An isolated node forms its own cluster. Edge directions and amounts in the graph remain unchanged.
methodology.limit.depth.title: Depth 4
methodology.limit.depth.description: outgoing transfers may be cut off. A zero O does not confirm that the node is terminal.
methodology.limit.seed.title: Seed node
methodology.limit.seed.description: incoming flows are incomplete, so the flow ratio is not used to assign a role.
methodology.limit.outflow.title: O > I
methodology.limit.outflow.description: this indicates incomplete coverage, not “anomalous profit”.
methodology.limit.difference.title: I − O
methodology.limit.difference.description: must not be described as an account balance or remaining funds.
methodology.limit.coverage.title: Coverage
methodology.limit.coverage.description: the KZT 5,000 threshold, the selected period and coverage limited to one bank restrict what can be observed.
methodology.depthExample: For a node at depth 4, incoming transfers are visible, but outgoing transfers are unknown because observation stops at the fourth hop. A final recipient has not been confirmed.
methodology.aiDescription: The AI receives facts about the selected nodes and explains them in plain language. If the service is unavailable, the graph, ranking and CSV exports keep working. Every explanation remains a hypothesis to review.
